desc_en: A calculated fusion of athletic aesthetics and urban sophistication. This grey set redefines the modern silhouette with clean lines and an imposing character. Crafted for the woman who demands presence and distinction in every movement. Its structured design offers an impeccable drape, while subtle finishes elevate the piece into a dimension of contemporary luxury. Made to order with worldwide shipping.
